thread:
Hannah: We need a lightweight feature-flag plan for 'retina-routing' rollout. Customers want per-tenant opt-outs, clear kill-switches, and a measurable A/B window. Can we sketch cohorts, gates, and who owns what?
Diego: Sketch: phased by region + tenant class. Start: alpha tenants (0.5%) -> beta tenants (5%) -> region ramp (25%) -> global. Hold windows: 20m infra signal checks + 2h quality observation at each step.
Maya: For experiments add a 5% randomized control slice per region (session-sticky). Run shadow logging for 24h after enabling so we capture non-sampled regressions.
Hannah: Telemetry gates proposal: short-window (15m) check on 5xx, queue depth, and per-shard CPU. Long-window (2h) for p95 latency and quality evals. Abort if 5xx delta > 0.35% absolute OR p95 increases > 25%. Also require cost-per-token delta < 12% to proceed.
Diego: Fallback policy idea: three tiers - (1) model-variant fallback (retina -> retina-quant) for memory pressure, (2) regional route fallback to legacy router when region 5xx breaches, (3) tenant-level override for enterprise opt-out. Throttle auto-fallback: max 10% of traffic fallback per minute to avoid cascade.
Maya: Experiment acceptance criteria: primary = session_success_rate on our eval suite. Require drop <= 1.0%. Secondary checks: top-50 prompt regressions reviewed, perplexity delta. If any critical hallucination pattern appears, rollback immediately.
Hannah: Communication plan: send targeted advisory 48h before any >20% exposure. Include opt-out steps and a short KB with rollback playbook. For accounts tagged 'high-touch' require an SE call before >10% exposure.
Diego: Infra checklist: reserve 15% spare capacity in each region during first two ramps, prewarm KV + prefix cache shards, and create a canary pool with pinned instances. I'll add scripts to infra/playbooks.
Maya: Observability: I'll build dashboard 'retina_routing_canary' (errors, latencies, cost_delta, quality_score). Also surface top prompt diffs and a small-multiple per-tenant view.
Hannah: Runbook snippet for toggle (ops quick revert):
```
# quick revert whole-region
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/v1/toggle \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"flag":"retina_routing_enable","scope":"region","region":"eu-west-1","value":false}'
# verify propagation
curl https://routing.internal/health?region=eu-west-1
```
Diego: CI smoke test requirement: synthesize a 10% 5xx spike for 90s and assert route-level fallback triggers within 40s and the flag toggle completes within 90s. This must be in gating for rollout PRs.
ops-bot: deploy-scheduler: retina-routing:v2 canary scheduled -> start 2026-10-10T12:00Z (alpha cohort 0.5%). Monitor: #eng-oncall.
SE-Team: We'll draft the customer advisory and include a one-click opt-out form. Also prepare templated SE talking points for customers who ask to pause.
Maya: Metric emission ask: add metric 'routing.retina.fallback.reason' with labels {region,tenant,reason} and a counter for fallback_count to detect patterns.
Diego: Owner assignments: Diego = infra & fallback automation, Maya = metrics & dashboards, Hannah = PM owner & comms. Who will write the RFC?
Hannah: I'll draft the RFC and the release checklist this afternoon. Can we get thumbs by EOD?
Maya: Thumbs from me. I'll start wiring alerts and the post-rollback validation job (100 golden prompts).
Diego: I'll add the infra scripts and CI smoke tests.
Hannah: Great. Locking owners and timeline. Thanks all :raised_hands:
